params.name: organization_id
params.description:
The ID of the organization.
Prefix with name= to retrieve the organization by name instead.

params.name: filter[plan]
params.description: The plan type of the subscription.

params.name: filter[status]
params.description: The status of the plan record.

params.name: filter[start]
params.description: The start of the observation period for the record. E.g. filter[start]=2018-01-01 will display all records that were active (i.e. did not end) on 2018-01-01

params.name: filter[end]
params.description: The end of the observation period for the record. E.g. filter[end]=2018-01-01 will display all records that were active on (i.e. they started before) 2018-01-01

params.name: filter[started_at]
params.description: The record's start timestamp. You can use this filter to list records started after, or before a certain time. E.g. filter[started_at][value]=2020-01-01&filter[started_at][operator]=>

params.name: filter[ended_at]
params.description: The record's end timestamp. You can use this filter to list records ended after, or before a certain time. E.g. filter[ended_at][value]=2020-01-01&filter[ended_at][operator]=>

params.name: page
params.description: Page to be displayed. Defaults to 1.

items.docs: Retrieves plan records for the specified organization.
